verdict.rationale: Working Copy has a 'Repository Agent' AI assistant that can browse, search, read/modify files, commit, pull and push via conversation, which could plausibly be used to review and suggest changes to a PR from the phone, but there is no evidence of PR-specific analysis, diff/code-review suggestions, or integration with GitHub/GitLab PR objects. missing for 10: explicit PR review/analysis capability, evidence of code-improvement suggestions tied to pull requests, hands-on confirmation of this workflow working reliably.
